import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv\("data/NRI_Table_Counties.csv", low_memory=False\)

risk_cols = ['HRCN_RISKS', 'HWAV_RISKS', 'WFIR_RISKS', 'CFLD_RISKS', 'DRGT_RISKS']

# Confirm all columns exist
missing = [c for c in risk_cols if c not in df.columns]
if missing:
    print\(f"Missing columns: {missing}"\)
else:
    print\("All columns present."\)

# Filter and compute composite score
clean = df[['STCOFIPS', 'STATE', 'COUNTY'] + risk_cols].copy\(\)
clean['composite_hazard_score'] = clean[risk_cols].mean\(axis=1\)

clean.to_csv\("data/fema_hazard_clean.csv", index=False\)

print\(f"Saved {len\(clean\)} rows x {len\(clean.columns\)} columns to data/fema_hazard_clean.csv"\)
print\("\\nSample:"\)
print\(clean.head\(5\).to_string\(\)\)
print\("\\nDescriptive stats for composite_hazard_score:"\)
print\(clean['composite_hazard_score'].describe\(\)\)
EOF)

Bash(venv/bin/python3 - << 'EOF'
import requests, csv, io, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings\("ignore"\)

url = "https://data.cms.gov/sites/default/files/2024-05/358947e6-6f10-4fb8-88ad-7b97c686d37d/mup_dme_ry24_p05_v10_dy14_geor.csv"
r = requests.get\(url, timeout=30, stream=True\)

# Read 200KB to sample geographic levels
content = b""
for chunk in r.iter_content\(65536\):
    content += chunk
    if len\(content\) > 200000:
        break

lines = content.decode\("utf-8", errors="replace"\).split\("\\n"\)
reader = csv.DictReader\(io.StringIO\("\\n".join\(lines\)\)\)
rows = list\(reader\)

geo_levels = set\(row.get\("Rfrg_Prvdr_Geo_Lvl",""\) for row in rows\)
print\("Geographic levels found:", geo_levels\)
print\("Total rows sampled:", len\(rows\)\)
EOF)
